notes: Add a friendly randomised welcome toast on startup. When setup is already done, checkFirstRunSetup now shows a greeting using the name captured during first-run setup (served by /setup-status as userName) — e.g. 'Hey Keith, how are you today?'. When no name was saved it falls back to a name-less variant ('Hey, ...'). Messages are randomised from a pool of 8 per language and fully localised (EN + JA: '{name}さん、...' with no opener when anonymous). The toast is a bottom-centre pill (z-index above all chrome so it clears the Timeline editor header), auto-dismisses after 6.5s, has a manual close, and shows once per browser session (sessionStorage 'welcome-shown') so reloads don't re-nag. Entrance uses a forced reflow rather than requestAnimationFrame so it animates reliably even when rAF is throttled. Name is rendered via textContent (user input, never innerHTML).
